categories.title: All
categories.description: Browse all available duas from the collection.

duas.title: When waking up
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillaahil-lathee ahyaanaa ba'da maa amaatanaa wa ilayhin-nushoor.
duas.translation: All praise is for Allah who gave us life after having taken it from us and unto Him is the resurrection.

duas.title: Before sleeping
duas.arabic: بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا
duas.translation: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.

duas.title: The Talbiya for the one doing Hajj or Umrah
duas.arabic: لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ، إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ وَالنِّعْمَةَ، لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ، لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ
duas.transliteration: Labbayk Allaahumma labbayk, labbayk laa shareeka laka labbayk, innal-hamda, wan-ni'mata, laka walmulk, laa shareeka laka.
duas.translation: I am here at Your service, O Allah, I am here at Your service. You have no partner. I am here at Your service. Surely all praise, blessings, and dominion are Yours. You have no partner.

categories.title: Morning & Evening
categories.description: Daily adhkar for the start and close of the day.

duas.title: Morning remembrance
duas.arabic: أَصْـبَحْنا وَأَصْـبَحَ المـلْكُ للهِ
duas.translation: We have reached the morning and at this very time unto Allah belongs all sovereignty.

duas.title: Evening remembrance
duas.arabic: أَمْسَيْـنا وَأَمْسَى المـلْكُ للهِ
duas.translation: We have reached the evening and at this very time unto Allah belongs all sovereignty.

categories.title: Prayer
categories.description: Duas connected to salah and worship.

duas.title: Opening supplication in prayer
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، وَتَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ، وَتَعَالَى جَدُّكَ، وَلَا إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ
duas.transliteration: Subhaanak Allaahumma wa bihamdik, wa tabaarakasmuk, wa ta'aalaa jadduk, wa laa ilaaha ghayruk.
duas.translation: Glory is to You, O Allah, and praise. Blessed is Your name and exalted is Your majesty. There is no god but You.

duas.title: After the tashahhud before salam
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ وَمِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma innee a'oodhu bika min 'adhaabi Jahannam wa min 'adhaabil-qabr.
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of Hell and from the punishment of the grave.

categories.title: Praising Allah
categories.description: Words of praise, gratitude, and glorification.

duas.title: Words most beloved to Allah
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
duas.translation: How perfect Allah is and I praise Him.

duas.title: A statement of tawheed
duas.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ
duas.transliteration: Laa ilaaha illallaahu wahdahu laa shareeka lah.
duas.translation: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, without partner.

categories.title: Hajj & Umrah
categories.description: Supplications for the rites of Hajj and Umrah.

duas.title: The Talbiya for the one doing Hajj or Umrah
duas.arabic: لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ، إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ وَالنِّعْمَةَ، لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ، لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ
duas.transliteration: Labbayk Allaahumma labbayk, labbayk laa shareeka laka labbayk, innal-hamda, wanni'mata, laka walmulk, laa shareeka laka.
duas.translation: I am here at Your service, O Allah, I am here at Your service. I am here at Your service, You have no partner, I am here at Your service. Surely the praise, blessings, and dominion are Yours. You have no partner.

duas.title: The Takbeer passing the black stone
duas.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
duas.translation: Allah is the Greatest.

duas.title: Between the Yemeni corner and the black stone
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa aatinaa fid-dunyaa hasanatan wa fil-aakhirati hasanatan wa qinaa 'adhaaban-naar.
duas.translation: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and save us from the punishment of the Fire.

duas.title: When at Mount Safa and Mount Marwah
duas.arabic: إِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِنْ شَعَائِرِ اللَّهِ
duas.translation: Indeed Safa and Marwah are among the symbols of Allah.

duas.title: The Day of 'Arafah
duas.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.transliteration: Laa ilaaha illallaahu wahdahu laa shareeka lah, lahul-mulk, wa lahul-hamd, wa Huwa 'alaa kulli shay'in Qadeer.
duas.translation: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things capable.

duas.title: Remembrance at Muzdalifah
duas.arabic: فَاذْكُرُوا اللَّهَ عِنْدَ الْمَشْعَرِ الْحَرَامِ
duas.translation: Remember Allah at Al-Mash'ar Al-Haram.

duas.title: When throwing each pebble at the Jamarat
duas.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
duas.translation: Allah is the Greatest.

duas.title: When slaughtering or offering a sacrifice
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُمَّ مِنْكَ وَلَكَ
duas.transliteration: Bismillaah, wallaahu akbar, Allaahumma minka wa laka.
duas.translation: In the name of Allah, Allah is the Greatest. O Allah, from You and for You.

duas.title: Supplication for travel
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ
duas.transliteration: Subhaanallathee sakhkhara lanaa haadhaa wa maa kunnaa lahu muqrineen.
duas.translation: How perfect He is, the One Who has placed this at our service, and we ourselves would not have been capable of that.

duas.title: Returning from travel
duas.arabic: آيِبُونَ، تَائِبُونَ، عَابِدُونَ، لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ
duas.translation: We return, repent, worship, and praise our Lord.

categories.title: Joy & Distress
categories.description: Duas for ease, hardship, and emotional moments.

duas.title: For anxiety and sorrow
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي عَبْدُكَ، ابْنُ عَبْدِكَ، ابْنُ أَمَتِكَ
duas.translation: O Allah, I am Your servant, son of Your servant, son of Your maidservant.

duas.title: When receiving pleasant news
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ
duas.translation: All praise is for Allah by whose favor righteous deeds are completed.

categories.title: Nature
categories.description: Duas related to rain, wind, and natural signs.

duas.title: When it rains
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَيِّبًا نَافِعًا
duas.translation: O Allah, make it beneficial rain.

duas.title: When hearing thunder
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي يُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ مِنْ خِيفَتِهِ
duas.transliteration: Subhaanallathee yusabbihur-ra'du bihamdihi wal-malaa'ikatu min kheefatih.
duas.translation: Glory is to Him whom thunder and the angels glorify due to fear of Him.

categories.title: Good Etiquette
categories.description: Duas for manners and everyday interactions.

duas.title: Entering the home
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا، وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا، وَعَلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا
duas.transliteration: Bismillaahi walajnaa, wa bismillaahi kharajnaa, wa 'alallaahi Rabbinaa tawakkalnaa.
duas.translation: In the name of Allah we enter, in the name of Allah we leave, and upon our Lord we place our trust.

duas.title: Before eating
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
duas.translation: In the name of Allah.
